steps.title: Prepare Fluorescent Probes
steps.instruction: Prepare the fluorescent probes for DNA/RNA (SYTO-82) and/or protein (SYPRO Orange) at a concentration of 0.000005.

steps.title: Perform Temperature Ramping
steps.instruction: Conduct temperature ramping using a CFX Connect Real-Time PCR Detection System (BioRad, MFPL).
